why: This is a named, study-adapted self-report measurement instrument rather than a reusable instructional element.
name: WPAI: SHP questionnaire adapted for academic performance impairment (API) in wartime students
product_description: A university-student adaptation of the Work Productivity and Activity Impairment: Special Health Problems questionnaire that measures self-rated academic performance impairment and mental-health-related study absenteeism over a 14-day recall period.
